d_ttft.introText:
Vic
12:56 PM
I'm Vikram — his AI clone, speaking from his CV. I'm Scrum Master / Project Manager on the ATO's Payday Super program and open to Scrum Master and delivery-leadership roles in Melbourne. Sixteen years across government, finance and telecommunications; at ANZ I ran a $5M+ portfolio across up to 40 practitioners. Ask about availability, the ATO work, or how I lead.

Vic
HIRING FIT
12:56 PM
At the ATO since March 2026, I lead the Agile Kookaburras squad on the Payday Super reform program, managing sprint cadence, PI planning, capacity and executive reporting. I steered the Distribution UI delivery past 95% completion and resolved stalled NTP function testing by escalating environment instability. I also architected COBOL/mainframe test automation that cut test-evidence effort by about 92%, enabling a feasible SIT window and formal go/no-go gates.
